name: fix-seed-rls-claims
description: Fixed seed.py to set RLS claims before create_workspace to prevent 'requires an authenticated sub claim' error
Why: The demo workspace seed script was failing with 'requires an authenticated sub claim' because the app.create_workspace() SQL function reads app.current_user_id() which depends on RLS claims being set in the session. The fix ensures claims are set before the call.
How to apply: In backend/app/demo/seed.py, import set_tenant_claims from app.security.rls and call it with the demo owner's user ID before calling func.app.create_workspace() in the same transaction/session. The set_tenant_claims function uses set_config(..., is_local=True) which is transaction-scoped and won't leak to other connections.
